svg.title: Deepvault — Dry archive over water
svg.desc: Raised archive shelves straddle an observation channel. Rolling ladders and table tops reach the rubbing desk, then a kelp rope drops to the return aisle. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Raised archive shelves straddle an observation channel. Rolling ladders and table tops
reach the rubbing desk, then a kelp rope drops to the return aisle.
